request.style: English, male, deep baritone, solo, slide guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, slow blues, melancholic, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Comfort falls like morning light
Your God speaks to the soul tonight
Speak tenderly to the city gate
Her hard service is paid and late

[Verse]
Guilt is washed away in the rain
Double payment for the pain
A voice cries out through the night
Prepare the way in the light

[Chorus]
In the wilderness prepare the way
Make straight in the desert a highway for our God
Every valley lifted high
Mountains made low to the sky

[Verse]
Rugged ground becomes a plain
Rough places smoothed by His name
The glory of the Lord is seen
All flesh together in the green

[Chorus]
In the wilderness prepare the way
Make straight in the desert a highway for our God
Every valley lifted high
Mountains made low to the sky

[Bridge]
A voice says cry out loud
What shall I cry in this crowd
All flesh is grass and flower
Fading like dust on the power

[Chorus]
In the wilderness prepare the way
Make straight in the desert a highway for our God
Every valley lifted high
Mountains made low to the sky

[Outro]
The mouth of the Lord has spoken
Comfort is never broken
